jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Strategic Project & Escalation Manager (f/m/d), you play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful execution of Siemens Energy's most critical GIS (gas insulated switchgear) and AIS (air insulated switchgear) customer projects across Europe. Your work directly contributes to delivery performance, customer satisfaction, and the sustainable growth of our Grid Technologies business.No two days are alike. Depending on the situation, you may lead strategic initiatives, manage high-impact escalations, assess contractual implications, prepare executive decision papers, facilitate cross-functional workshops, or support leadership teams in defining priorities across a dynamic project portfolio.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead strategic cross-functional projects and support business transformation initiatives across Order Management Switchgears Europe* Coordinate the resolution of critical project escalations and drive actions to mitigate schedule, delivery, and execution risks* Establish transparency regarding project risks, opportunities, constraints, and priorities to support effective decision-making and with that, contribute to a proactive escalation culture focused on transparency, accountability, and customer success* Collaborate with Project Managers, Regional Leaders, and Senior Management to align project priorities, resource allocation, and business decisions* Analyze customer contracts and commercial commitments, and prepare decision materials, business cases, status reports, and management presentations* Facilitate alignment and solution development across Order Management, AIS, GIS, Logistics, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, and Customer Center organizationsWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a comparable discipline* Many years of experience in complex project management, program management, order execution, or a related business environment, including cross-functional initiatives and escalation management involving multiple stakeholders and organizational interfaces* Strong understanding of customer projects within an industrial, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, or engineering environment* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills and the ability to navigate technical, commercial, contractual, and operational topics while balancing strategic decisions with hands-on problem solving* Experience in project governance, stakeholder management, executive communications, and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment* Outstanding communication, presentation, negotiation, and collaboration skills, and you are fluent in German and English, both written and spokenAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. jobs.description: PhD Position (m/f/d) – Krombach FellowFull- or Part-time | Fixed-term (36 months) | Institute of Human GeneticsJoin an internationally recognized research team investigating the genetic foundations of sleep disorders through large-scale genomic analyses and machine learning. Build reproducible, version-controlled analysis pipelines on high-performance computing and cloud platforms. - Present research findings within an international consortium and contribute to high-impact scientific publications.Your profile:- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in bioinformatics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, machine learning, human genetics, epidemiology, or a closely related quantitative discipline. - Experience working with large datasets and high-performance computing environments to manage computationally intensive genomic analyses. - Interest in human disease biology and motivation to translate genetic discoveries into clinically relevant insights through collaboration with clinicians and experimental researchers. - Excellent written and spoken English skills to communicate findings effectively within an international research consortium and at scientific conferences.We offer you:- A temporary position with the possibility of extension- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers, company bike -
